report_name: Ransomware Attacks Hit All-Time High in August 2026

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: The most active ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) group in August 2026, claiming 157 victims. The group employs a double-extortion model and is known to disable security software before deploying its ransomware.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through ransomware and data exfiltration.

threat_actors.name: The Gentlemen
threat_actors.description: A highly active ransomware gang responsible for 107 attacks in August 2026.

threat_actors.name: Clop
threat_actors.description: A resurfaced ransomware group that posted 45 new victims in August 2026, primarily by exploiting a vulnerability in PTC Windchill software.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through mass exploitation of single vulnerabilities.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The core tactic of the ransomware attacks, where victim files are encrypted to extort payment.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: Used as part of a double-extortion model where data is first exfiltrated before being encrypted. The use of tools like rclone for bulk data exfiltration is associated with this technique.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Used by the Clop group as a primary initial access vector, specifically by exploiting a vulnerability in PTC Windchill software.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Mentioned as a common technique for ransomware groups to gain initial access or move laterally within a network by using purchased or stolen credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Disable or Modify Tools
attack_patterns.description: Used by ransomware groups like Qilin to disable security software before deploying the ransomware payload to ensure successful encryption.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware precursors include deleting volume shadow copies using commands like 'vssadmin delete shadows' to prevent easy restoration of encrypted files.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
attack_patterns.description: Adversaries use command-line interfaces and scripting languages like PowerShell to download payloads and disable security features.

malware.name: Qilin Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload deployed by the Qilin group as part of their double-extortion attacks.

malware.name: Clop Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware associated with the Clop group, used in attacks exploiting the PTC Windchill vulnerability.

tools.name: rclone
tools.description: A legitimate data synchronization tool often abused by ransomware groups for bulk data exfiltration before encryption.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: A Windows command-line utility abused by ransomware groups to delete volume shadow copies, hindering system recovery.

vulnerabilities.name: PTC Windchill Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: An unspecified vulnerability in PTC Windchill software exploited by the Clop ransomware group to gain initial access to victim networks.

identities.name: Utilities Sector
identities.description: The utility sector was heavily impacted by ransomware in August 2026, with the number of attacks doubling.

identities.name: Healthcare Sector
identities.description: The healthcare sector saw a 30% increase in ransomware attacks, threatening patient care and sensitive data.

identities.name: Legal Sector
identities.description: The legal sector experienced a 52% increase in ransomware attacks in August 2026.

identities.name: Technology Sector
identities.description: The technology sector experienced a 42% increase in ransomware attacks in August 2026.

identities.name: Finance Sector
identities.description: The finance sector experienced a 40% increase in ransomware attacks in August 2026.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b8a1b9d-5e7d-4b1f-8a2c-0d6e4f3a2b1d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common precursor to ransomware deployment.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-14
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/ransomware/global-ransomware-attacks-hit-record-997-in-august-2026-as-utility-healthcare-and-business-attacks-surge/
tags:
  - attack.t1490
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of vssadmin to delete volume shadow copies, a technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: PowerShell Download Activity
indicators.pattern:
title: PowerShell Download Activity
id: 9d4e5f6a-7b8c-4012-8def-123456789012
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell being used to download payloads from the internet, a common technique for ransomware precursors.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-14
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/ransomware/global-ransomware-attacks-hit-record-997-in-august-2026-as-utility-healthcare-and-business-attacks-surge/
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1105
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'WebClient'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'iwr'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects PowerShell being used to download payloads from the internet, a common activity associated with ransomware precursors.
